scoringCalibration: No point is awarded yet. The mouth now has a real opening in a baked subdivision surface, skinned lip volume and collision-safe deformation, but the lip silhouette remains too regular and the face still lacks expression-compatible continuous perioral loops.
visualFindings: The mouth is cut through the level-one baked body surface instead of being drawn over an opaque coarse face.
The outer black outline from the v40 lip sheets is reduced and the oral cavity provides actual depth behind the wet margin.
The upper and lower lips use five authored profile rows and a render-only second subdivision level; the runtime exports one subdivision level.
The front view is cleaner, but the side silhouette and repeated highlight rhythm remain visibly procedural.
rejectedExperiments: A 51-card crown patch was rejected because it produced comb-like floating lines in the overhead view.
Using the body skin material directly on a detached transition strip was rejected because missing body vertex-color data rendered a black border.
The first baked-body render was rejected because subdivision faces retained flat shading and exposed concentric facets.
Head-bone-only lip binding was rejected after frame 20 produced 243 body/upper-lip and 79 body/lower-lip overlaps.
Runtime lip subdivision level two was rejected because the full GLB exceeded 8 MiB.
blockingFailures: The perioral region still needs continuous expression-oriented edge loops, asymmetric sculpt refinement and a phoneme pose suite.
Integrated upper and lower eyelid thickness and expression-compatible canthus topology remain below review quality.
The crown needs a coherent authored direction field with a narrower irregular part and fewer cross-flow fibers.
Hair shading still needs an engine-side dual-lobe anisotropic model and strand-scale roughness variation.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the standard pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
